events.title: DecisionRAG lets language models navigate document hierarchies without a first-stage retriever
events.title_zh: DecisionRAG 让模型直接导航文档层级
events.summary: DecisionRAG uses a language model as a decision model that jointly scores branches of a document hierarchy without generating tokens or relying on a first-stage retriever. The authors report gains over dense retrieval plus an 8B reranker on MultiDoc2Dial and Natural Questions, with 0.7–1.8 second retrieval across four benchmarks. No public implementation or independent reproduction was identified.
events.summary_en: DecisionRAG uses a language model as a decision model that jointly scores branches of a document hierarchy without generating tokens or relying on a first-stage retriever. The authors report gains over dense retrieval plus an 8B reranker on MultiDoc2Dial and Natural Questions, with 0.7–1.8 second retrieval across four benchmarks. No public implementation or independent reproduction was identified.
events.summary_zh: DecisionRAG 把语言模型当作 decision model，在不生成 token、也不依赖第一阶段检索器的情况下，共同判断文档层级中的候选分支。作者报告它在 MultiDoc2Dial 与 Natural Questions 上超过 dense retrieval 加 8B reranker，并在四个 benchmark 上把单次检索控制在 0.7–1.8 秒。当前未发现公开实现或独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For RAG teams, the work challenges the standard retrieve-then-rerank pipeline by moving model judgment into hierarchical navigation. Without code, cost breakdowns or independent tests, it is a design signal rather than a production choice.
events.why_it_matters_en: For RAG teams, the work challenges the standard retrieve-then-rerank pipeline by moving model judgment into hierarchical navigation. Without code, cost breakdowns or independent tests, it is a design signal rather than a production choice.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 RAG 团队来说，这项工作把模型判断前移到层级导航，挑战了常见的“先检索、再重排”流水线。缺少代码、成本拆解和独立测试，目前更适合作为架构信号，而不是生产选型。

events.title: REVA screens functions for vulnerabilities in one model pass
events.title_zh: REVA 用一次模型前向计算筛查函数漏洞
events.summary: REVA combines a module threat model, static-analysis findings and call-graph context, then reads an LLM’s internal representation with a trained probe. On PrimeVul’s held-out test set, the authors report 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function on GLM-5.3-Flash, similar to their VulTriage comparison while over 250 times faster. No public code or independent validation was identified.
events.summary_en: REVA combines a module threat model, static-analysis findings and call-graph context, then reads an LLM’s internal representation with a trained probe. On PrimeVul’s held-out test set, the authors report 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function on GLM-5.3-Flash, similar to their VulTriage comparison while over 250 times faster. No public code or independent validation was identified.
events.summary_zh: REVA 把模块威胁模型、静态分析结果和调用图上下文一起交给 LLM，再用训练过的 probe 读取模型内部表示。作者在 PrimeVul held-out 测试集上报告：GLM-5.3-Flash 约一秒筛查一个函数，准确率 60.0%，与其复跑的 VulTriage 接近，但速度快 250 倍以上。当前未发现公开代码或独立验证。
events.why_it_matters: For teams reviewing agent-generated code, REVA suggests a cheap screening layer before slower agentic investigation. The absolute accuracy remains too low for autonomous blocking, and the unpublished implementation prevents operational validation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams reviewing agent-generated code, REVA suggests a cheap screening layer before slower agentic investigation. The absolute accuracy remains too low for autonomous blocking, and the unpublished implementation prevents operational validation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对审查 agent 生成代码的团队来说，REVA 提供了一条先低成本筛查、再交给慢速 agent 深挖的思路。但绝对准确率仍不足以自动阻断，未公开实现也无法做工程验收。

technical_details.evidence_limit: Author-reported preprint; no code or independent validation found

events.title: dSpark learns token reveal schedules for faster diffusion language models
events.title_zh: dSpark 学习 token 揭示顺序来加速扩散语言模型
events.summary: dSpark distills token-unmasking schedules that reveal positions which reduce uncertainty elsewhere, rather than simply revealing the most confident token first. The authors report 10.12 tokens per forward pass on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 5.12 on Dream-7B-Instruct while preserving benchmark accuracy. Training and evaluation code is public, but model checkpoints and training data are still promised for a later release and the repository has no declared license.
events.summary_en: dSpark distills token-unmasking schedules that reveal positions which reduce uncertainty elsewhere, rather than simply revealing the most confident token first. The authors report 10.12 tokens per forward pass on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 5.12 on Dream-7B-Instruct while preserving benchmark accuracy. Training and evaluation code is public, but model checkpoints and training data are still promised for a later release and the repository has no declared license.
events.summary_zh: dSpark 蒸馏 token 解掩码顺序，优先揭示能降低其他位置不确定性的 token，而不是只选当前最有把握的 token。作者报告 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 每次前向计算可确定 10.12 个 token，Dream-7B-Instruct 为 5.12 个，同时保持 benchmark 准确率。训练与评测代码已公开，但模型 checkpoint 和训练数据仍承诺稍后发布，仓库也没有声明许可证。
events.why_it_matters: For diffusion-language-model serving, scheduling can change wall-clock cost without changing the base architecture. Missing checkpoints, data and license metadata make the current release unsuitable for a bounded production trial.
events.why_it_matters_en: For diffusion-language-model serving, scheduling can change wall-clock cost without changing the base architecture. Missing checkpoints, data and license metadata make the current release unsuitable for a bounded production trial.

events.title: Study finds simple LLM harnesses beat hand-crafted root-cause agents
events.title_zh: 研究发现简单 LLM harness 胜过手工编排的根因分析 agent
events.summary: A study compares three simple LLM harnesses with five published root-cause-analysis agents plus statistical and causal baselines on RCAtlas. Across 90 validated incidents from eight public datasets, six models and three reasoning efforts, the authors report that simple harnesses reach 65–77% PR@1 on three mid-tier models versus 16–53% for the hand-crafted agents. The paper does not link a public implementation or independent reproduction.
events.summary_en: A study compares three simple LLM harnesses with five published root-cause-analysis agents plus statistical and causal baselines on RCAtlas. Across 90 validated incidents from eight public datasets, six models and three reasoning efforts, the authors report that simple harnesses reach 65–77% PR@1 on three mid-tier models versus 16–53% for the hand-crafted agents. The paper does not link a public implementation or independent reproduction.
events.summary_zh: 一项研究在 RCAtlas 上比较三种简单 LLM harness、五个已发表的根因分析 agent，以及统计和因果基线。实验覆盖八个公开数据集中的 90 个已验证故障、六个模型和三档 reasoning effort。作者报告：三种中档模型上的简单 harness 达到 65–77% PR@1，手工编排 agent 为 16–53%。论文没有链接公开实现或独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For observability and incident-response teams, the result warns that fixed stages and role agents can hide decisive evidence and add cost. The comparison is broad enough to influence prototype design, but not yet strong enough to replace production evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For observability and incident-response teams, the result warns that fixed stages and role agents can hide decisive evidence and add cost. The comparison is broad enough to influence prototype design, but not yet strong enough to replace production evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对可观测性和事故响应团队来说，这项结果提醒：固定阶段和角色 agent 可能跳过关键证据，还会增加成本。比较范围足以影响原型设计，但还不能替代生产环境里的自有评测。

events.title: Cloudflare discloses cross-request KV cache exposure in Workers AI
events.title_zh: Cloudflare 披露 Workers AI 跨请求 KV cache 泄露
events.summary: Cloudflare disclosed that 155 GLM-5.3 Workers AI responses exposed data from other customers between August 27 and September 9. A KV pool smaller than the advertised context window combined with an SGLang disaggregated-inference bug, causing over-length requests to attend to stale cache pages. Cloudflare restored the model after correcting the configuration and patching the engine, and reports no evidence of deliberate exploitation or impact to other models.
events.summary_en: Cloudflare disclosed that 155 GLM-5.3 Workers AI responses exposed data from other customers between August 27 and September 9. A KV pool smaller than the advertised context window combined with an SGLang disaggregated-inference bug, causing over-length requests to attend to stale cache pages. Cloudflare restored the model after correcting the configuration and patching the engine, and reports no evidence of deliberate exploitation or impact to other models.
events.summary_zh: Cloudflare 披露，8 月 27 日至 9 月 9 日间，Workers AI 的 GLM-5.3 有 155 条响应混入其他客户的数据。根因是 KV pool 小于声明的上下文窗口，又叠加 SGLang 分离式推理的拒绝路径缺陷，使超长请求读到旧 cache page。Cloudflare 修正配置并补丁引擎后恢复模型；其调查未发现蓄意利用，也未发现其他模型受影响。
events.why_it_matters: For teams running disaggregated inference, a successful HTTP response does not prove tenant isolation or coherent long-context behavior. Operators should upgrade SGLang, assert that KV capacity covers the advertised context and test response content across independent tenants.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running disaggregated inference, a successful HTTP response does not prove tenant isolation or coherent long-context behavior. Operators should upgrade SGLang, assert that KV capacity covers the advertised context and test response content across independent tenants.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行分离式推理的团队来说，HTTP 成功不等于租户隔离正确，也不等于超长上下文输出可信。应升级 SGLang、强制检查 KV 容量覆盖声明上下文，并用独立租户做内容级隔离测试。

technical_details.trigger: Prompts longer than 681,280 tokens against a 1,048,576-token advertised context
technical_details.root_cause: KV pool configuration mismatch plus an SGLang rejected-request bug in disaggregated prefill/decode mode
technical_details.remediation: Cloudflare enlarged the pool, patched rejection handling and hardened production deployments; operators are advised to use SGLang v0.5.22 or later
technical_details.evidence_limit: Scope and non-exploitation findings are Cloudflare incident-response conclusions
technical_details.time_basis: Cloudflare incident report published 2026-10-26T22:01:23.889Z; underlying exposure occurred August 27–September 9

technical_details_zh.触发条件: 声明上下文为 1,048,576 token，但 prompt 超过 681,280 token
technical_details_zh.根因: KV pool 配置不匹配，加上 SGLang 分离式 prefill/decode 的拒绝请求缺陷
technical_details_zh.修复: Cloudflare 扩大 KV pool、修复拒绝路径并强化生产部署；建议 operator 使用 SGLang v0.5.22 或更高版本
technical_details_zh.证据边界: 影响范围与未发现蓄意利用的结论来自 Cloudflare 事故调查
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Cloudflare 于 2026-10-26T22:01:23.889Z 发布事故报告；实际暴露发生在 8 月 27 日至 9 月 9 日

events.next_action_zh: 将 SGLang 升到 v0.5.22 以上，并在每次部署时校验 KV pool 容量、超长请求拒绝和跨租户 canary。
events.next_action_en: Upgrade SGLang to v0.5.22 or later and validate KV-pool capacity, over-length rejection and cross-tenant canaries on every deployment.

evidence.claim_zh: Cloudflare 的协调披露确认 GLM-5.3 Workers AI 曾发生跨请求 KV cache 数据暴露，并给出修复与 operator 升级要求。
evidence.claim_en: Cloudflare’s coordinated disclosure confirms cross-request KV-cache exposure on GLM-5.3 Workers AI and documents remediation and operator upgrade requirements.
evidence.verification: verified primary incident report; scope conclusions remain provider-reported

changes.summary_zh: Cloudflare 披露并修复跨请求 KV cache 泄露
changes.summary_en: Cloudflare discloses and remediates cross-request KV-cache exposure

events.title: Baidu releases Unlimited-OCR-2 weights for ultra-long documents
events.title_zh: 百度发布面向超长文档的 Unlimited-OCR-2 权重
events.summary: Baidu published MIT-licensed Unlimited-OCR-2 weights, code, a demo and a new ultra-long-document benchmark. Its Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention keeps a fixed set of working references while parsing longer documents, and the model supports Transformers plus a customized SGLang path. Baidu reports leading results on multi-page benchmarks, but the comparisons have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_en: Baidu published MIT-licensed Unlimited-OCR-2 weights, code, a demo and a new ultra-long-document benchmark. Its Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention keeps a fixed set of working references while parsing longer documents, and the model supports Transformers plus a customized SGLang path. Baidu reports leading results on multi-page benchmarks, but the comparisons have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_zh: 百度公开了 MIT 许可的 Unlimited-OCR-2 权重、代码、demo 和新的超长文档 benchmark。它用 Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention 保留固定数量的工作引用，让文档继续变长时不必让每一步的计算和显存同步增长，并支持 Transformers 与定制 SGLang 路径。百度报告它在多页 benchmark 上领先，但对比结果尚未独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For document-RAG teams, a bounded-memory OCR path could reduce the need to split long reports before parsing and preserve cross-page context. The practical question is whether accuracy, latency and memory hold on real scans outside the vendor benchmark.
events.why_it_matters_en: For document-RAG teams, a bounded-memory OCR path could reduce the need to split long reports before parsing and preserve cross-page context. The practical question is whether accuracy, latency and memory hold on real scans outside the vendor benchmark.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对文档 RAG 团队来说，有界显存的 OCR 路径可能减少预先切碎长报告的需要，并保留跨页上下文。真正需要验证的是，它在真实扫描件上能否保持准确率、延迟和显存表现。

technical_details.method: Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA) with a fixed working-reference set such as 512 tokens
technical_details.availability: MIT-licensed weights, code, demo, ModelScope and Baidu Cloud access
technical_details.runtimes: Transformers and a customized SGLang serving path
technical_details.evidence_limit: Benchmark leadership and scaling claims are vendor-reported; no independent reproduction found
technical_details.time_basis: Hugging Face repository created 2026-10-26T03:57:46Z with model uploads that day; the release list labels the public launch 2026-10-27 without a time, so this is a recall-audit late discovery

technical_details_zh.方法: Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention（SR-SWA），保留固定工作引用，例如 512 token
technical_details_zh.可用性: MIT 许可权重、代码、demo，并提供 ModelScope 与百度智能云入口
technical_details_zh.运行方式: Transformers 与定制 SGLang serving 路径
technical_details_zh.证据边界: benchmark 领先与扩展性结论由百度报告；未找到独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face 仓库创建于 2026-10-26T03:57:46Z，模型文件同日上传；发布列表只标 2026-10-27、没有时分，因此按召回自检 late discovery 补录

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 10 份含表格、跨页段落和扫描噪声的真实 PDF，对比当前 OCR 的准确率、峰值显存和每页延迟。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare accuracy, peak memory and per-page latency against the current OCR on 10 real PDFs with tables, cross-page passages and scan noise.

evidence.claim_zh: 百度已公开 Unlimited-OCR-2 的 MIT 权重、代码与推理说明；性能结论仍待独立复现。
evidence.claim_en: Baidu publishes MIT-licensed Unlimited-OCR-2 weights, code and inference instructions; performance claims await independent reproduction.
evidence.verification: verified public artifacts; benchmark claims remain vendor-reported
